derivation: from an obsolete particle (implying negation) and G2031 (νήπιος);
strongs_def: not speaking, i.e. an infant (minor); figuratively, a simple-minded person, an immature Christian
it_def:
1) un infante, piccolo bambino
2) un minore
3) metaforicamente infantile, privo di istruzione, non abile
